ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, fetched 2026-09-22, all 603,730 registered studies walked in one pass. Population: interventional, an ACTUAL primary
completion date, not phase 1 — 253,429 studies. This is broader than the set FDAAA 801 actually binds: the register carries no
applicable-clinical-trial flag, and two of the statute's four tests cannot be applied here at all, since IND/IDE status is never published and the
US-site criterion needs a location field not fetched. So no rate on this plate is a rate of law-breaking; it is reporting behaviour in a stable
population. Curves stop where a cohort's follow-up runs out or its denominator falls below 500.
